model: page count + LRU residency lanes (int page, long tick, Control)
delta_ops: setPageCount(n) releases pages >= n only; showPage(i) materializes one page; releasePage(i)
damage: layout of the parent only (top control bounds); no page is created or laid out except the one shown
full_rebuild_paths: none: setPageCount never recreates resident pages
proof: M3StackLayoutTest, M3ResidentPagesTest, M3StackLayoutDifferentialTest (pixels and Show/Hide sequence vs StackLayout)
resize_sweep: BY DESIGN: a resize lays out the top control only (resident pages keep empty bounds); 50-size sweep pending
hidden_gate: BY DESIGN: non-top pages are released or kept without layout; PartVisible feed pending (rule 25)

delta_ops: setValue(r,c,v) repaints its cell when on screen; update(fromRow,toRow) repaints the on-screen band of that row range; setOrigin scrolls (Control.scroll) and repaints the exposed strip
damage: cell or row band rectangle, clipped to the client area
whole_view_repaint_only_on: setSize, setPalette, setRange/autoRange widening (every cell colour changes)
full_rebuild_paths: none: no per-cell objects to rebuild
proof: M3HeatMapTest (cell repaint rectangles, band update, off-screen value change repaints nothing)
resize_sweep: OPEN: a resize repaints the whole client area (no NO_REDRAW_RESIZE yet); fix and sweep next
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 10^4 setValue, show: 0 paints, 0 probes while hidden; 1 paint pass; pixels equal a fresh map

model: ints (frame, points, trail, delay, icon size) + point centre lanes xs/ys + trail shade array
delta_ops: setFrame / timer tick repaints the icon square only; setText repaints the text strip only; setTrailLength / setPointCount repaint the icon only
full_rebuild_paths: none: shades rebuilt only on colour, trail or point count change; a frame allocates nothing
proof: M3BusyLabelTest (frame paints inside the icon, text paints inside the strip, same frame or text repaints nothing, pixels after 5 frame deltas equal a direct paint)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths, full repaints 0, paints only right of min(old, new) width; height change = 1 full repaint (re-centre)
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 10^4 frame+text deltas, show: 0 paints, 0 probes; 1 paint; pixels equal a fresh label; the timer parks while hidden

model: slot lanes (mode, value, measured, x, width) + text lane + control lane
delta_ops: setText repaints its slot; a preferred slot that changes width repaints from itself on; setControl / updateSlot / removeSlot relayout from that slot; layout moves only controls whose slot changed
damage: slot rectangle, or the strip from the first changed edge to the end
whole_view_repaint_only_on: setFont (every measure changes), height change (every baseline moves)
full_rebuild_paths: none: content measured on change only, never on resize or layout
proof: M3StatusBarTest (tiling by prefix sums and cumulative rounding, slot-only repaints, growth repaints from the slot, controls follow, pixels after deltas equal a fresh bar)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 2 bars x 50 widths, full repaints 0, paints only right of the first weighted slot (or the grip when none), a fixed-slot control never moves; height change = 1 full repaint
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 3 x 10^4 text deltas, show: 0 paints, 0 measures while hidden; stale preferred slots measured once on reveal; 1 paint; pixels equal a fresh bar

model: ints (extent, target, full width/height, steps, delay) + flags
delta_ops: setCollapsed measures the content once, then each frame changes the extent and slides the content (setLocation, no resize); a collapsed content is hidden (not laid out, not painted)
damage: none drawn (the pane has no paint); the parent re-lays out this pane only (layout(Control[]))
full_rebuild_paths: none: the content is measured once per state change, never per frame or resize
proof: M3CollapsiblePaneTest (measured once and laid out 0 times during an animation, collapsed content hidden, reversals finish once, horizontal axis)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths expanded (content measured 0 times, width follows) and 50 widths collapsed (content laid out 0 times)
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): a status bar inside a collapsed pane takes 2 x 10^4 deltas with 0 paints, 1 probe (hidden ancestor), 0 measures; expanding gives 1 paint pass; PartVisible feed pending (rule 25)

model: message, severity, throwable (stack trace formatted lazily) + stale flags
delta_ops: setMessage reflows the message label only; setError stores the throwable (formatted when the details are first needed); the details text control is created on first show and reused
full_rebuild_paths: none: details formatted and created once, on demand
proof: M3ErrorPaneTest (details created on first show and reused, report text, dialog)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 2 x 50 shell widths: details never formatted or created by a resize; the details control is reused
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 3 x 10^4 message, severity and error deltas, show: 0 paints while hidden, the latest message in the label after 1 paint

model: node lanes (kind, parent, first, last, next, weight, bounds) + control lane
delta_ops: moveDivider / setWeight re-lay out the parent split only; cumulative rounding keeps every other sibling in place; unchanged subtrees are skipped; dividers damaged at old and new place
damage: old and new divider strips; controls whose bounds changed
full_rebuild_paths: none: no measuring on layout; preferred sizes only in computeSize
proof: M3MultiSplitPaneTest (exact tiling, a divider move changes two siblings and leaves D untouched, mouse drag, errors)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths, exact tiling after every step, full repaints 0, measures 0
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 10^4 setWeight, show: 0 paints, 0 moves while hidden; 1 layout + 1 paint on show; bounds equal a fresh pane

model: pattern, generation, current row, sorted hit lane (int[]), count
delta_ops: a keystroke starts a superseding generation: first match from the current row, then a sliced count (SLICE rows per turn) filling the hit lane; next/previous/ordinal by binary search over the hit lane; modelChanged recounts
damage: status label and the revealed row only
full_rebuild_paths: none: rows read from the model by index, never from items; no allocation per scanned row
proof: M3FindBarTest (first match, 1000 of 10^6 counted, steps and wrap by the hit lane, match case, only the last of three superseded searches reveals, under 512 KB allocated for a 10^6-row scan)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths read no row and repaint nothing in full
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 10^4 setText, show: 0 rows read while hidden, 1 reveal starts one search

model: title, image, special, hover + an M3CollapsiblePane body
delta_ops: title / image / special / hover repaint the title bar only; collapse repaints the chevron only and slides the content; a collapsed content is hidden (its viewports fold deltas)
full_rebuild_paths: none: the title bar height is measured once per font or image change
proof: M3TaskPaneTest (click toggles, chevron-only repaint, title repaint)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 container widths: stacking exact, title bar repaints only the chevron at old and new place, full repaints 0
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide the title bar, 2 x 10^4 title and special deltas, show: 0 paints, 1 paint pass

model: height and top lanes per child + the SWT-flushed child list
delta_ops: a child that changes size (expand, collapse, animation frame) is the only child measured again; children above are untouched, children below are moved, not resized
full_rebuild_paths: none: measures only flushed children; a width change measures all (content may wrap) but moves only changed bounds
proof: M3TaskPaneTest (collapse: pane above untouched, pane below moved not resized, other contents neither measured nor laid out)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths, exact stacking after every step
hidden_gate: BY DESIGN: no own paint; hidden children fold their own deltas

model: text, measured width/height, visited, hover, colours
delta_ops: hover, focus and visited repaint the text rectangle; setText repaints the union of old and new text rectangles
full_rebuild_paths: none: text measured once per change, never on resize or paint
proof: M3HyperlinkTest (click, Enter and Space activate and mark visited, click beside the text ignored, text-rectangle repaints)
resize_sweep: SWEEP WRITTEN (UI run pending): 50 widths, paints only right of min(old, new), measures 0, full repaints 0
hidden_gate: TEST WRITTEN (UI run pending): hide, 2 x 10^4 text and visited deltas, show: 0 paints, 0 measures; 1 paint; pixels equal a fresh link
